CustomField.description:
Ths is used to determine whether the date part of the Appointment_Date_Time__c field is equal to yesterday's date. Here's a breakdown of the formula:
DateValue(Appointment_Date_Time__c): This part of the formula extracts the date component from the Appointment_Date_Time__c field, which seems to be a DateTime field. DateValue is used to ignore the time part and only focus on the date.
TODAY() - (1): This calculates the date for yesterday. TODAY() returns today's date, and subtracting 1 from it gives you the date for one day before, i.e., yesterday.
If(DateValue(Appointment_Date_Time__c) = TODAY() - (1), TRUE, FALSE): This If statement checks if the date component of Appointment_Date_Time__c is equal to yesterday's date. If it is, the formula returns TRUE; otherwise, it returns FALSE.
In essence, this formula is used to flag records where the Appointment_Date_Time__c field's date is equal to yesterday's date.
CustomField.label: Appointment Date - Yesterday
